1. First-line: IV NSAIDs (ketorolac) + antiemetics (metoclopramide or prochlorperazine) + diphenhydramine
2. If refractory: triptans, DHE
3. Opioids are generally avoided

So the answer would be "non-opioid" as the first-line analgesic approach.
